outcome: The application collector records the admitted source and builder bytes before producing artifacts, compares exact source snapshots afterward, and withdraws only this invocation copies if inputs changed or final verification failed. It retains an incomplete release or diagnostic manifest with original admitted provenance, changed-input details or an explicit unverified/error result. Stable initial dirty inputs remain eligible; prior artifacts survive.

validation.independentBetweenTargetDrift: Diagnostic hub/link fixture withdraws both current copies and preserves prior sentinel; retained original v1 evidence is reused for unchanged code paths.

inputScopes.missing: Missing admitted paths are recorded explicitly; unsupported or unreadable final inputs leave verification null/unstable, never a partial accepted snapshot.

proofLimits: Snapshots compare start/end bytes; a temporary mutation restored between reads is not detected. This is not atomic build or module-loading confinement.
